_comment: Every file the public build emits must belong to an included component here. redistribution: allowed | reference_only | local_only | blocked | unverified. Licence evidence was read from primary texts on 2026-09-23; see docs/decisions.md and docs/recommendations/10-assets-and-licences.md.

components.licence: MIT (Nexus code); npm runtime dependencies are checked separately
components.note: Requires the LICENSE file to exist; the gate checks that separately.
Upstream LICENSE.md and the installed copy both read. Keep ThirdParty.json and notices. Individual transitive assets inside the runtime are not independently cleared.
Local LICENSE is identical to upstream. The MIT grant covers source code only; its third-party data and assets are excluded. Notice kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

components.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth); world-atlas package is ISC
components.note: Bundled into the JavaScript through world-atlas. Suitable for context, not for certifying a strait or port.
The page states: 'All data in Wikidata has a CC0 license.' Coordinates in geography.json come from here.
Public use of the keyless endpoint is not established. Public build uses the Natural Earth globe until settled.

components.licence: ODbL data; tile service policy applies separately
components.note: The data licence is not permission for unlimited tile hosting. Disabled for public release.

components.licence: OFL-1.1, copyright The Inter Project Authors
components.note: Self-hosted in apps/shell/public/fonts by scripts/nexus-fetch-fonts.mjs (subsetted woff2 from Google's font API, hashes in fonts/manifest.json). Attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; the full licence text still has to be bundled before release. Mind the Reserved Font Name condition if modified.

components.licence: OFL-1.1, copyright The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
components.note: Self-hosted in apps/shell/public/fonts as for Inter. Attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; the full licence text still has to be bundled before release.

A subset of Material Symbols Outlined limited to the glyphs the shell names (list in apps/shell/index.html), self-hosted as above. The repository LICENSE was verified; the subset file is a derivative served by Google's font API.

The shell's stylesheets are adapted from upstream (foundation, command dock, overlays and the rest, pruned in step B15). Keep the copyright and modification notice; apps/shell/UPSTREAM.md records the changes.
Removed 2026-09-25: location.svg, visual-presets.svg and pin.svg had no per-file provenance. They were replaced by icons drawn for Nexus (see nexus-icons); nothing from this entry ships.

components.licence: Mixed: CC BY-NC-SA, ODbL, CC BY-NC, per-model CC BY, unknown
components.note: Bundled in the God's Eye repository outside its MIT grant. Must never enter the Nexus build.

components.licence: MIT (Nexus); drawn for this project from plain geometry
components.note: The Nexus mark and three small interface icons, replacing upstream's logo and unverified icons. Simple shapes (circles, lines); no third-party artwork.
